## Activity tags (Clockify)

Project says who pays; the tag says what kind of work it was. One or more per entry.

| Tag | Use for |
|---|---|
| Project Management | Scheduling, sub coordination, procurement, client updates |
| Consultation | Advice, assessments, and calls where the advice is the deliverable |
| Design | Drawings, specs, engineering, layout |
| Estimating | Quotes, takeoffs, proposals |
| Site visit | Time on site to inspect, measure, or meet; not hands-on work |
| Fabrication | Shop work: building parts, furniture, assemblies |
| Install | Putting fabricated or purchased work in place |
| Service | Small trade-level jobs and repairs (handyman calls) |
| Preventative maintenance | Scheduled upkeep: filters, inspections, seasonal tasks |
| Concierge | Non-trade household help under property management: furniture assembly, IT help, picture hanging, meeting utilities |
| Administrative | Bookkeeping, invoicing, email, tooling |
| Travel | Driving and supply runs |

- Service vs. Preventative maintenance: unplanned fix vs. scheduled upkeep.
- Concierge vs. Service: no trade skill needed vs. trade work (Service usually goes under a CW code).
- The list lives in Job Ledger settings and must match Clockify exactly; Sync creates any that are missing.
